acceptance.criterion_verbatim: look at the fixture render -- would an analyst tell at a glance which figures failed, and would the real blocks' PROVISIONAL figures (held-back rule) read as "not yet checked" rather than as "fine"?
acceptance.output_evidence: check_face_fixture.md's 5 rows: 'Fixture Co' and '500' render plain; '[REFUSED: EBITDA_FIXTURE: unit/sign convention is 'INFERRED', not MEASURED]' and '[REFUSED: CAPEX_FIXTURE: unit/sign convention is 'SIGN-UNRESOLVED', not MEASURED]' render as bracketed text WHERE A NUMBER WOULD BE -- an analyst scanning the column would see a broken-looking cell, not a plausible number, at both REFUSE rows; this is the strongest of the three signals (a REFUSE cannot be mistaken for a value at all). '12345 [PROVISIONAL]' keeps the number visible with a suffix tag -- LESS visually distinct than a REFUSE bracket, since the number is still the dominant text in the cell; AT A GLANCE (a fast scan, not a careful read) a PROVISIONAL row is more likely to be skimmed as 'a number, fine' than a REFUSE row is to be mistaken for one. This is a REAL LIMIT of the current print-path text rendering, named rather than hidden: the task's own s.1 spec section (SPEC_SECTION_checkface.md) says the eventual .tsx needs a DIFFERENT visual marker (colour/icon) for PROVISIONAL precisely because bracket text alone is not equally salient to REFUSE's -- that is a DEFERRED design decision, not something this cell's plaintext render can supply. On BABA_US_Equity.md: 103 of 196 rows carry '[PROVISIONAL]' (real data, not a fixture) -- e.g. 'header:CUR_MKT_CAP | 269839299644.40002 [PROVISIONAL]'. Read against the question's second half ('read as not-yet-checked rather than fine'): the word PROVISIONAL itself denotes non-finality in English, and it sits immediately beside the number rather than, say, in a footnote -- so a reader who reads the word at all should not conclude 'fine'. But 103 of 196 rows (53%) carrying the tag on ONE security is a lot of ink, and a reader scanning quickly across that many tagged rows may habituate to the tag and stop registering it -- a volume effect this cell's render does not address (BA_US's 10-of-179 REFUSE rows are a much smaller fraction and less likely to habituate the same way). DECLARED, NOT RESOLVED: whether 53% PROVISIONAL is itself a signal that the currency_caveat root cause (BABA_US_Equity's PE/CRNCY reconciliation gap) should be chased down rather than carried forward as a per-figure flag is a question for the cell that owns that finding, not this one.
